Name: So, King of Egypt
Summary: So, king of Egypt, was the ruler to whom Hoshea sent messengers and withheld Assyria's tribute, a conspiracy Shalmaneser discovered before Samaria fell.
RelatedPeople: Hoshea, King of Israel; Shalmaneser, King of Assyria
LifeLesson: Egypt's help has always been a broken reed for kings who will not trust God.
